entities.name: Query protein 768 aa
observations: Sequence analysis reports 768 residues, estimated mass 88.32 kDa, pI 5.10, GRAVY −0.469, and charge at pH 7 of about −30.
Exact Swiss-Prot alignment to A3CNT9 ADDA_STRSV spans the entire query but only 62.7% of the longer 1,224-aa target, consistent with a partial-length match to an AddA-family protein.
Pfam detects UvrD-helicase (residues 30–471; i-Evalue 1.2e−56) and UvrD_C (482–763; i-Evalue 8.6e−11), supporting helicase-family classification.
No catalytic equation or transferred functional annotation was returned; the specific function remains inferred from the strong AddA homolog match and domains.
